title: Spectra of averages of unitary representations of LCA groups
summary: Let $G$ be a locally compact Abelian (LCA) group with dual group $Γ$, and let $μ$ be a probability measure on (the Borel sets of) $G$. Given a unitary representation $\{U(t): t \in G\}$ in a complex Hilbert space $H$, we study the spectrum of the $μ$-average $V:=\int_G U(t)dμ(t)$ (defined in the strong topology of $H$). We prove that $σ(V) \subset \overline{\hatμ(Γ)}$ and give a sufficient condition for equality.
